name: geothermal-resource
title: Global subsurface temperature and sustainable heat flow
description: Global 1-degree grids of rock temperature at ten depths (1000 to 10000 m), mean surface temperature, and sustainable geothermal heat flow in W/m2. Produced by David Franzmann for RESKit's Enhanced Geothermal System workflow. The temperature model and source combination are described in Franzmann, Heinrichs and Stolten (2025), section 2.3, equation (1).

ethos:upstream.note: These grids were produced locally. Their three original input products and the conductivity coefficient workbook are now separate catalogue entries. The related Mendeley results release has not been verified to contain these two particular resource grids.

sources.title: Franzmann, D., Heinrichs, H. and Stolten, D. (2025): Global geothermal electricity potentials: A technical, economic, and thermal renewability assessment. Renewable Energy 250, 123199. Section 2.3, equation (1)
Goutorbe et al. (2011), surface heat flow and radiogenic heat production
Hartmann and Moosdorf (2012), GLiM v1.0 at 0.5 degrees
NASA POWER climatology, Earth Skin Temperature TS at 0.5 degrees

Thermal conductivity coefficients: Franzmann's mapping workbook, CC BY 4.0, catalogued as geothermal-conductivity-assumptions, whose values are from Aghahosseini, Arman and Breyer, Christian (2020): From hot rock to useful energy. Applied Energy 279, 115769, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apenergy.2020.115769, Table 1.
